units.time: seconds since first accepted sample in each segment

sequence_policy: First device+sender IP only; duplicates/reordering excluded. Backward counters after 2 s silence start a new segment.
data_validation: Software capture only; motion/labels require experiment validation.

analysis_magnitude.csv.filter: 4th order Butterworth, cutoff=min(5 Hz, 0.4*fs), zero-phase sosfiltfilt
analysis_magnitude.csv.resampling: median device-time spacing per continuous span; linear interpolation
analysis_magnitude.csv.note: Short spans also need >15 samples for filtering. Peaks are algorithm outputs, not labels.
